Best Bar in Phu Quoc
Aug 2026 • Couples
This is a fabulous little bar if your staying anywhere near the night market area of Phu Quoc. It's down an alley way next to a King Kong Mart on the main drag. The atmosphere is awesome and the food is top quality. The beer and other drinks are very cold, not always like that in VN. Prices are very reasonable (it has happy hour and live music) and the staff are awesome. Do yourself a favour and search this place out, you won't be disappointed.
